summary: Cut eight more upward module references around store, relay_trace and otel; the module allowlist shrinks from 28 to 20 pairs

replay.detail: Definitions move between modules and keep their paths through re-exports. No claim, projection or replay behaviour changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, schema version or migration changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol, harness, route, CLI output or exit code changes. The daemon registers the reconciler's metrics right after its telemetry starts instead of inside it, under the same condition (metrics exporter running).

downtime.detail: Nothing to restart beyond a normal upgrade.
